entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(x:∈Class)((x set)→∃(u:∈Class)(((u universe)∧(x∈u))∧(u set))))

entries.title: General form of the induction principle on a transitive class
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(K:∈Class)∀(A:∈Class)((Tr(K)∧((K∩𝒫(A))⊆A))→(K⊆A)))

entries.title: Soundness of the theory 𝘛
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:∈Fm)((𝘛,[]⊢𝛗)→eval(𝛗)))
entries.comment: Local reflection / soundness schema for the recursively enumerable (r.e.) base theory of classes 𝘛: if (𝘛, [] ⊢ φ), then the explicit formula valuation ⟦φ⟧ holds in the fixed background model.

entries.title: Soundness of the theory 𝘍
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:∈Fm)((𝘍,[]⊢𝛗)→eval(𝛗)))
entries.comment: 𝘍 is a non-recursively-enumerable (non-r.e.), Henkin-complete extension of the r.e. base theory 𝘛 (𝘛 ⊆ 𝘍). Because 𝘍 is non-r.e., Gödel's incompleteness theorems do not apply to 𝘍 itself, and 𝘍 is postulated with full soundness (𝘍, [] ⊢ φ) → ⟦φ⟧.

entries.title: Completeness of the theory 𝘍
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:∈Fm)(eval(𝛗)→(𝘍,[]⊢𝛗)))
entries.comment: Negation-completeness of the non-r.e. Henkin extension 𝘍: for every sentence φ, if ¬φ is not derivable in 𝘍, then φ is derivable in 𝘍.

entries.title: If a formula is derivable in 𝘛, then it is derivable in 𝘍
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(Γ:∈Ctx)∀(𝛗:∈Fm)((𝘛,Γ⊢𝛗)→(𝘍,Γ⊢𝛗)))
entries.comment: Theory extension monotonicity (𝘛 ⊆ 𝘍): every theorem of the r.e. base theory 𝘛 is also a theorem of its non-r.e. Henkin completion 𝘍.

entries.title: Ordered pair(Dunaev's tagged class pair)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(A:∈Class)∀(B:∈Class)((A,B)=(({{∅,{∅}}}∪{x|∃(a:∈Class)((a∈A)∧(x={{{{a}}},{∅}}))})∪({{∅,{∅,{∅}}}}∪{x|∃(a:∈Class)((a∈B)∧(x={{{{a}}},{∅,{∅}}}))}))))
entries.comment: Dunaev tagged class ordered pair (A,B) = mark(A,1) ∪ mark(B,2), sound for arbitrary proper classes.

entries.title: First projection of Dunaev's tagged ordered pair
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(A:∈Class)∀(B:∈Class)({a|{{{{a}}},{∅}}∈(A,B)}=A))
entries.comment: Recovers A from (A,B) via tag 1 without requiring A or B to be sets.

entries.title: Second projection of Dunaev's tagged ordered pair
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(A:∈Class)∀(B:∈Class)({b|{{{{b}}},{∅,{∅}}}∈(A,B)}=B))
entries.comment: Recovers B from (A,B) via tag 2 without requiring A or B to be sets.

entries.title: Instantiation(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(A:∈Type)∀(G:∈Ctx.Expression)∀(𝛗:∈Fm)∀(t:∈eval(A).Expression)∀(v:∈Variable)(𝘞,⟦G⟧⊢‹(∀(⦃v⦄:∈⟦A⟧)⟦𝛗⟧)→(let ⟦v⟧ = ⟦t⟧ in ⟦𝛗⟧)›))

entries.title: Generalisation(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(A:∈Type)∀(Γ:∈Ctx)∀(𝛗:∈Fm)∀(v:∈Variable)((¬(Enc(⦃v⦄)∈Ctx.FV(Γ)))→((𝘞,Γ⊢𝛗)→(𝘞,Γ⊢‹∀(⦃v⦄:∈A)⟦𝛗⟧›))))
entries.comment: (A theory 𝘞 is assumed here to contain only formulas without free variables, so the variable x has no free occurences in any formula of a set of formulas [|Dec(Theory.Expression)(W)|]. Here Enc(v) (μ_Variable(v) : Variable.Expression → Class.Expression) denotes the explicit typed term interpretation / valuation homomorphism mapping a typed term of sort A into a term of sort Class while respecting the fixed model and variable valuation.)

entries.title: CoNecessitation(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(Γ:∈Ctx)∀(𝛗:∈Fm)((𝘍,[]⊢‹𝘍,Γ⊢𝛗›)→(𝘍,Γ⊢𝛗)))
entries.comment: If a formula  is derived in 𝘍 from the empty context, then the formula 𝛗 is derived in 𝘍 from the context Γ. Why this holds for 𝘍: for an arbitrary theory 𝘞, concluding (𝘞, Γ⊢𝛗) from (𝘞, [] ⊢ ) requires 1-consistency / Σ_1-soundness of 𝘞 (and for the r.e. base theory 𝘛, asserting internal co-necessitation would by Löb's theorem 5.01 trivialize 𝘛). Because 𝘍 is a non-r.e. sound Henkin extension equipped with Soundness 3.73 ((𝘍, [] ⊢ ψ) → ⟦ψ⟧), instantiating 3.73 at ψ :=  directly yields (𝘍, Γ⊢𝛗).

entries.title: Quantifier “unique”(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:∈Fm)((!(z:∈Class)⟦𝛗⟧)⟷(∀(x:∈Class)∀(y:∈Class)((⟦𝛗[(x:∈Class)/‹z›]⟧∧(let z = y in ⟦𝛗⟧))→(x=y)))))

entries.title: Quantifier “exists and unique”(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:∈Fm)(𝘛,[]⊢‹(∃!(x:∈Class)⟦𝛗⟧)⟷((∃(x:∈Class)⟦𝛗⟧)∧!(x:∈Class)⟦𝛗⟧)›))

entries.title: Class comprehension axiom schema(meta,WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:∈Fm)∀(x:∈Name)∀(k:∈Class.Expression)(FFI((k:∈Class),‹x›,(𝛗:∈Bool))→(𝘛,[]⊢‹(⟦k⟧∈{⦃x⦄|⟦𝛗⟧})⟷((⟦k⟧ set)∧(let x = ⟦k⟧ in ⟦𝛗⟧))›)))

entries.title: Löb's theorem(WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (∀(𝛗:∈Fm)(𝘌,[]⊢‹(𝘛,[]⊢‹(𝘛,[]⊢𝛗)→⟦𝛗⟧›)→(𝘛,[]⊢𝛗)›))
entries.comment: Here 𝘌 ∈ {IΣ_1, 𝘛, NBG, MK} is an elementary metatheory capable of proving the Hilbert-Bernays-Löb derivability conditions D1-D3 for the r.e. base theory 𝘛 (specifically D3, Σ_1-completeness, which requires Σ_1-induction and fails in Robinson's arithmetic Q; see Hájek & Pudlák 1993, Metamathematics of First-Order Arithmetic, Ch. I §3 & Ch. III; Bezboruah & Shepherdson 1976, JSL 41(2):503-512; Boolos 1993, The Logic of Provability, Ch. 2).

entries.title: Gödel's second incompleteness theorem(WIP)
entries.formula_unicode_html: (𝘌,[]⊢‹(¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹⊥›))→¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹¬(𝘛,[]⊢‹⊥›)›)›)
entries.comment: Formalized in the elementary metatheory 𝘌 ∈ {IΣ_1, 𝘛, NBG, MK} (not Robinson's Q, which lacks Σ_1-induction needed for HBL condition D3; cf. Hájek & Pudlák 1993; Bezboruah & Shepherdson 1976) for the recursively enumerable object theory 𝘛. Note that Gödel's second incompleteness theorem applies to the r.e. theory 𝘛, whereas 𝘍 is non-r.e.
